evidence_access.this_host: Windows, RTX 5070 Laptop sm_120, 8GiB, no torch/CUDA env

question: Can hierarchical work-constrained sampling (shared 16x16 parent list+sort, internal 4x4 child sampling) beat G16 on gradient quality at lower real GPU work, specifically undercut Native G4?
hypothesis: H-HWCS: two-stage sampling (parent q, child r, marginal p=q*r, HT 1/p) yields an unbiased estimator whose (work, NMSE) point lies below the G16<->NativeG4 segment.
falsification_conditions: hierarchical variance not a convex blend of G4/G16 variance (MC-validated, NOT falsified)

HWCS structural work >= Native-G4 work under the ASSUMED cost model AND the N1 dense-bin-then-mask baseline. NOTE: the undercut is a property of the structural cost model + N1 only; it is NOT a GPU-time result and does NOT apply if Native-G4 uses N2 (mask-then-bin). kappa is a cost-model parameter, not count-identifiable.
at matched work a G16/G4 mixture beats HWCS (HWCS loses only at kappa=1.0 in 5/9 states)
measured GPU-time advantage absent (BLOCKED: no Native-G4 or HWCS CUDA exists)

evidence_classes.OBSERVED: G16/G4/G8/G1 geometry-macro NMSE at p in {0.25,0.4}; dense bbox intersection proxies I_G16,I_G4; audit hashes; MX GPU snapshots
evidence_classes.RECOMPUTED: K-calibration, HWCS NMSE blend, work model, dominance, equal-cost ratios
evidence_classes.DERIVED: variance identity, alpha blend, work-floor break-even kappa*, segment sweep
evidence_classes.HYPOTHESIS: HWCS NMSE (predicted), child-refine efficiency kappa, GPU-time realization
evidence_classes.BLOCKED: real HWCS NMSE, real CUDA timing, kappa, native-G4 baseline design (N1 vs N2), time-to-quality, camera heterogeneity, paired CIs

key_findings.variance_identity: Var_HWCS = (1-alpha)*Var_G4 + alpha*Var_G16, alpha = r*(1-q)/(1-p); HWCS-1 alpha=1/3, HWCS-2 alpha=1/9  [CORRECTED: denominator was mis-typed 1-p*q*r=1-p^2; numerical alpha always used 1-p, MC-verified]
key_findings.nmse_ordering: G4 <= HWCS-2 <= HWCS-1 <= G16 in 9/9 OBSERVED states (valid because within-parent cross-terms were non-negative there); scene-dependent, NOT universal - blend identity is the universal part

work_saving_vs_nativeG4_p25_conservative._conditioning: VALID ONLY under (a) the assumed structural cost model (bin+sort ~ linear in intersection entries, GAM=1) and (b) Native-G4 = N1 dense-bin-then-mask. If Native-G4 = N2 (mask-then-bin), Native-G4 avoids dense work and HWCS has NO structural edge. These are intersection-count proxies, NOT measured GPU time.

key_findings.g4_work_floor_undercut: UNDER N1 + the assumed cost model only: HWCS-1 structural work < Native-G4 dense-binning floor in 9/9 states for every cost-model kappa in [0,1] (break-even kappa*=2-4/rho in [1.14,1.57], all >1; all states rho>4). This is NOT unconditional: it fails for N2 and is a proxy, not GPU time. kappa* is a cost-model break-even, NOT an empirically measurable threshold.

matched_work_vs_nativeG4._conditioning: N1 + assumed cost model only. HWCS-2 result also requires the cost model; not a GPU-time claim.

segment_mixture_dominance.finding: HWCS BELOW G16/G4 mixture for kappa<=0.75 (9/9); ABOVE (dominated) at kappa=1.0 in 5/9
segment_mixture_dominance._conditioning: Cost-model dependent (kappa sweep). 'Below mixture' means below the G16/G4 chord UNDER THE ASSUMED WORK MODEL; not a measured result and assumes N1.

decisive_unmeasured: child-refine operation-cost efficiency kappa: a COST-MODEL parameter that CANNOT be uniquely identified from intersection counts. Stage B-min reports child-refine ENTRY COUNTS (a structural count) and per-camera paired gradient statistics; it does NOT measure kappa. kappa requires Stage C CUDA timing with identical baselines.
GPU-time realization (no Native-G4 or HWCS CUDA; all timing NOT_MEASURED)
native-G4 baseline design: dense-binning N1 (HWCS-favorable) vs mask-then-bin N2 (HWCS-neutral)

stage_b_feasibility.minimal_stage: Stage B-min PyTorch oracle, full-render+matched-loss, NO CUDA build, 0 training steps

verdict_options_considered.CODEX_FEASIBILITY_GO: REJECTED - all quality/cost numbers are proxy or predicted; nothing measured on GPU; hinges on unmeasured kappa and unconfirmed N1 baseline
verdict_options_considered.CONDITIONAL_RESEARCH: SELECTED - math sound (MC-validated <0.3%); HWCS-1 undercuts Native-G4 work floor in structural model; one cheap measurement (Stage B-min) decides GO vs DROP
verdict_options_considered.DROP_HWCS_CURRENT_DESIGN: REJECTED - feasibility NOT falsified; mechanism plausible and potentially Pareto-improving
verdict_options_considered.BLOCKED_EVIDENCE: REJECTED for Stage A - unlike WV0 we have a validated analytic model + reproducible proxies; but realization is blocked on measurement

rationale: Stage A proved the hierarchical variance math correct (MC <0.3%), reproduced the audit's equal-cost result, and showed HWCS-1 undercuts the Native-G4 N1 dense-binning work floor in 9/9 states UNDER THE ASSUMED STRUCTURAL COST MODEL (not N2, not GPU time) while beating G16 on quality. But every quality number is a blend prediction and every cost number is an intersection-count proxy; the decisive variable kappa and the GPU-time realization are unmeasured, and the advantage depends on Native-G4 using dense-binning (N1). Basic feasibility is not falsified, so the correct next step is the cheap Stage B-min measurement, not a Codex CUDA GO and not a DROP.
next_experiment: Stage B-min (controlling protocol = WV_HIER_R1_MX_STAGE_B_REVISED): extend _wv0_grad.py with the HWCS two-stage mask using COMMON RANDOM NUMBERS; run G16/G4(N1)/HWCS-1/HWCS-2 at matched p=0.25 on bicycle__iter15000 x 2 cams x 32 paired seeds; measure per-camera real HWCS gradient NMSE + paired bootstrap CI (blend-identity check), and report child-refine/parent ENTRY COUNTS as STRUCTURAL COUNTS (NOT kappa, NOT GPU time). Report BOTH N1 and N2 Native-G4 structural work. All full-render+masked-loss timing labeled SUPERVISION_ORACLE. 0 training steps, no CUDA edit. If evidence insufficient -> ORACLE_INCONCLUSIVE. See STAGE_B_REPORT.md.

answers_to_core_questions.1_can_HWCS_reduce_native_G4_cost: PLAUSIBLE_YES_IN_MODEL, N1+cost-model-conditional only - HWCS-1 undercuts the Native-G4 N1 dense-binning work floor by 22.8-31.3% in 9/9 states (structural proxy). Fails for N2. Not GPU time.
answers_to_core_questions.2_credible_quality_advantage_at_matched_: IN-MODEL ONLY - under the assumed work model HWCS sits below the G16/G4 chord for kappa<=0.75 (9/9); but NMSE is blend-predicted not measured, ordering is scene-dependent, and at kappa=1.0 it is dominated in 5/9. Stage B-min must confirm with per-camera paired CIs.
answers_to_core_questions.3_cannot_determine_from_raw_data: real HWCS NMSE, kappa, GPU-time realization, N1-vs-N2 baseline, CUDA intersection counts, time-to-quality, camera heterogeneity, paired CIs
answers_to_core_questions.4_worth_cuda_investment: NOT_YET. Stage B-min (gradient oracle + N1/N2 structural counts) first. A Codex CUDA prototype requires INDEPENDENT design + performance thresholds: (a) measured GPU kernel/F+B time vs BOTH N1 and N2 Native-G4 on matched p, (b) gradient-quality preservation vs G16, (c) a minimum E2E time-to-quality target. NO count-based kappa threshold (e.g. kappa<=0.5) is a valid CUDA GO gate; kappa is not count-identifiable. Any STRUCTURAL_POTENTIAL verdict is NOT CODEX_GO.
answers_to_core_questions.5_next_minimal_falsifiable_experiment: Stage B-min (STAGE_B_SPEC.md): 256 sparse + 2 dense evals, ~10-30 min on one idle A100, no CUDA build, 0 training steps
